find: Share this page
replace: Share this page${contactCard(w)}

find: A phone photo of a clipping or a booklet page works fine.
replace: Up to 25 MB per file. A phone photo of a clipping works fine. PDFs, audio and video are posted as they are.

find: fail(e,"Couldn't save that just now. Please try again in a minute.")
replace: fail(e,(err&&err.ttUser)?err.message:"Couldn't save that just now. Please try again in a minute.")

find: Photos are resized before upload, which removes location data.
replace: Photos are resized before upload, which removes location data. PDFs, audio and video are posted as they are, so check them for private details first.
